svg.title: Disturbance, energy and size: E4, E5 and E6
svg.text: Behaviour diversity, with and without disturbance
the world's energy is fixed and conserved
the same three worlds; the lines lie on each other
of 2,048, in a world of each size
Bold lines: the mean of sixteen seeds; faint lines: each seed. Each panel changes one thing against the
defaults: whether fires, floods and droughts happen; how much energy the world holds; how big it is.
